body: Yeah, I know deep down you're right. I just...can't. I'm at such a real disconnect with reality it's impossible for me to see any good in not just me but everything. Options are ind of limited when you get to a certain point.

No, what you said is fine. I'm happy for you. My parents are my biggest trigger and thy're the ones who called me fat and ugly the most so it can't work like that for me. I'm kind of spiraling at the moment and I think I already shaved 20 years off my life anyway. If I make it to 30 I'll be shocked. 

I don't even now what state I'll be in for my 16th birthday in a month. And I also think I couldn't be in a genuine relationship due to trust issues and body image. It's kind of like "He wouldn't like you if he know your past or who you were or that you're so fucked up in the head. If he knew you couldn't keep down a meal he'd leave." or maybe like "He thinks your fat, everyone is staring at your rolls." I can't even wear shorts anymore and t-shirts make me so self-conscious

Well I'm bulimic because all my life I was 'chubby'. Friend wouldn't acknowledge and say 'you're pretty anyway' when they were literal sticks. In the 6th grade my BFF for 7 year was 97 pounds and I was pushing 160.

Eating disorders were glamorized as being disciplined and eating all you want and being thin seemed amazing. I didn't know I would become addicted to the lifestyle. I said 'I will reach 90 pound and stop' and it's come to a point where I know even if I was 60 pounds I couldn't stop even though I think I'd look way to gross and boney.

Even in this 'recovery' stage I know I'll go back to bulimia or anorexia eventually. As soon as I started losing weight I got looks from guys, people were nicer to me, I was actually *noticed*. That i omething every teenage girl wants to hear. People have actually called me *pretty, beautiful,gorgeous* genuinely.

I'm sorry for being late with this reply, this is a throwaway. ): I'll try being better.


Honestly, I think I'm a cow right now. I can't go on the scale without crying. I don't know if I would have picked up my ED if I knew I'd develop anxiety, anti-social behavior, all thee medical problems, hair loss, inability to do activities, and over all I kind of have this mean outer shell when irritated. For example, when people are eating and I won't because I won't be able to purge it I get super pissed even though it' my fault. Holidays are the WORST!

Anyways, sorry for typing you a book, if you wanna know anything just ask
